name: Financial Analysis Demo
description: Two project scenarios with known Payback, NPV, IRR, and PI values for classroom illustration.

scenarios.name: Office Automation System
scenarios.description: A $100,000 investment in office automation expected to generate $30,000 per year for 5 years at a 10% discount rate. Payback ≈ 3.33 years, NPV ≈ $13,724, IRR ≈ 15.24%, PI ≈ 1.137.

scenarios.name: Warehouse Expansion
scenarios.description: A $200,000 warehouse expansion with uneven cash flows over 6 years at 8% discount rate. Growing inflows reflect ramp-up in utilisation.
